q03-sofia-writes-books.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, warm brown skin, bright smile), in her bright blue blazer over a white blouse with no badge, sits at a wooden desk by a sunny window in a home study and smiles at the camera while her right hand holds a black pen on the open page of a large notebook; the page shows only faint ruled lines. A stack of four plain dark-red books stands on the desk at the right, and a bookcase with plain pale books and a plant is softly behind her.
q03-sofia-writes-books.note: Usable. The pen is on the page and the writing reads at 180 px; the page and every spine are unreadable. In the centered 4:5 crop she, both hands, the pen and the notebook stay whole, but only the left edge of the red book stack remains; the grids contrast the action (writing vs reading, drinking, eating), which the crop keeps.

q01-luis-drinks-coffee.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin) in his plain navy crew-neck T-shirt sits at a wooden table in a bright white kitchen and drinks from a plain white mug held to his lips with his right hand, eyes on the camera; his left hand rests on the table. A plant, a plain knife block and white cabinets are softly behind him. Seen from the head to the waist, centered.
q01-luis-drinks-coffee.note: Usable. Drinking reads instantly at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop. The coffee itself is not visible and there is no steam: the mug is at his lips and its underside shows a dark recessed foot, so coffee is implied by the mug, not seen. Hands are natural; nothing is readable.

q02-ana-reads-books.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, warm smile) in her sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans sits on a light-grey sofa in a sunny living room and reads an open plain grey hardcover held in both hands, eyes on the page and smiling; a stack of three closed books with plain blue, green and red covers sits on the sofa beside her. Seen from the head to the knees, a little left of center.
q02-ana-reads-books.note: Usable. Reading reads instantly at 180 px; covers are plain and nothing is readable; both hands have five natural fingers. She looks some years older than in her reference photo (same hair, shirt and smile). In the centered 4:5 crop she, both hands and the open book stay whole; only part of the book stack remains.

q04-diego-eats-fruit.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full dark beard) in his burgundy button shirt without the blazer sits at a wooden table in a bright kitchen and bites a red apple with a bite already taken out of it, held to his mouth with his right hand, smiling with his eyes at the camera; a white bowl of red apples, oranges and yellow bananas sits on the table in front of him. Seen from the head to the waist, centered.
q04-diego-eats-fruit.note: Usable. Eating reads instantly at 180 px; the bitten apple and the fruit bowl stay whole in the centered 4:5 crop. Matches his reference closely; the hand is natural and nothing is readable.
